name: CRIApp Board
desc:
Use this simple Kanban template to keep the engineering team on the same page and moving through work fluidly. 

1. Break down the roadmap by adding tasks as cards to the **Backlog** list. 

2. Move the cards one-by-one through **Design** as they becomes more fleshed out. *Pro tip:* You can enable Power-ups for your favorite design tools like [Figma](https://trello.com/power-ups/59b2e7611e6ece0b35eac16a/figma) or [Invision](https://trello.com/power-ups/596f2cb2d279152540b2bb31), in order to easily link and view designs without switching context.

3. When a card is fully specced out and designs are attached, move it to **To Do** for engineers to pick up. 

4. Engineers move cards to **Doing** and assign themselves to the cards, so the whole team stays informed of who is working on what.

5. Cards then move through **Code Review** when they're ready for a second set of eyes. The team can set a **List Limit** (with the List Limit Power-up) on the number of cards in Code Review, as a visual indicator for when the team needs to prioritize reviews rather than picking up new work. 

6. Once cards move through **Testing** and eventually ship to production, move them to **Done** and celebrate!

card.desc:
La idea es crear la app para Android e iOS, y centralizar toda la logica de backend y base de datos en una WEB API para que las aplicaciones nativas de Android e iOS solo la consuman.

De esa forma, las tecnologías elegidas para el desarrollo son:

APP Android: Kotlin y Android Studio, pues son las tecnologías que estoy estudiando en clase.

WEB API: C#, .NET Core, EF Core y Rider, pues son las tecnologías que trabajo hace algunos años y ya las domino.

APP iOS: Swift y Xcode, pues quiero aprender más sobre el desarrollo para dispositivos Apple y también ya estaba indicado en la documentación que me envió.

Base de Datos: PostgreSQL, pues además de ser open-source yo ya tengo experiencia con el DBMS.

listing.name: Limites da lista
listing.description:
Se você definir um limite nas suas listas, realçaremos a lista caso o número de cartões dela ultrapasse esse limite.

![Depois que isso for habilitado, você encontrará a opção "Definir limite da lista..." no menu "Ações da lista".](https://plugin.trello.services/images/list-limits-demo-1.gif)

![A lista é realçada quando você excede o limite dela.](https://plugin.trello.services/images/list-limits-demo-2.gif)

[Leia esta publicação do blog para saber como otimizar o processo do seu time com limites de trabalho em andamento.](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/kanban/wip-limits)
